data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman family name Fabius. In Latin, faber means 'to create' or 'to make'. Fabiolas is a feminine variation of Fabius. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fabiolas usually hope their child will grow to embody little fabius and live with faith, good character and purpose.
